title: Rules and Regulations: Disconnection Notices Under the Electric Service Agreement
content:
**Tariff Rules and Regulations, Regulatory Affairs: written and final notices of disconnection for nonpayment of an Electric Service Agreement**

**(a) Conditions for a written notice.** A written notice may be issued only when the agreement's past-due balance is at least the schedule's minimum past-due amount for a notice and the oldest unpaid bill is at least the schedule's minimum number of days past its due date. The past-due balance, as of the handling date, is the total of the amounts of the agreement's bills whose due date is before the handling date plus all charges posted before the handling date, less all payments and credits posted on or before the handling date, and never below zero.

**(b) Eligible agreements.** Notices are delivered only on an agreement in active or notice pending status, as shown in the company's agreement records.

**(c) Content and delivery of the written notice.** The written notice is delivered by mail or email, states the past-due balance, and sets its earliest disconnect date to the notice date plus the schedule's written notice period in calendar days. Serving the written notice moves the agreement to notice pending.

**(d) Final notice.** A final notice is delivered by phone call or door hanger, while the written notice is pending, at least the schedule's final notice hours before disconnection.

**(e) Rescission.** The notice is rescinded and the agreement returns to active, with the rescission date recorded as the date of its last status change, when any of the following holds before disconnection:
1. payments since the notice bring the past-due balance below the schedule's minimum past-due amount for a notice;
2. a Payment Arrangement on the agreement becomes active;
3. under the Medical and Life-Support Protections, a medical postponement is granted for the agreement, or a medical certification whose kind bars disconnection becomes active;
4. the notice period expires without disconnection.

**(f) Winter moratorium.** Notices may be issued during the winter moratorium; the moratorium limits only disconnection.

## Notice conditions in combination (hypothetical)

| Past-due balance against the schedule's minimum | Oldest unpaid bill against the minimum days | Written notice |
|---|---|---|
| equal to the minimum | exactly the minimum days past due | may be issued |
| above the minimum | one day short of the minimum days | not issued |
| below the minimum | well past the minimum days | not issued |

## Earliest disconnect date (hypothetical)

*Hypothetical:* a written notice dated 3 November on a schedule whose written notice period is 10 days carries an earliest disconnect date of 13 November.
